node.label: Proximal femoral epiphysiolysis
node.definition: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis is defined as a posterior and inferior slippage of the proximal epiphysis of the femur onto the metaphysis (femoral neck), occurring through the physeal plate during the early adolescent growth spurt.

evidence.snippet: Stickler syndrome: Proximal femoral epiphysiolysis (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
